pyq_bad.why: suspect key/stem: says 'section 91' but the national-project provision is Section 90 (cf. yf19cf60f546); statements I-III are 90(2)-(4)

patterns: APPSC repeatedly asks 'which section of APRA 2014 makes Polavaram a national project' - answer Section 90 (distractors 80, 70, 60).
Statement form reproducing 90(2)-(4) verbatim (Union control, Telangana consent deemed, Centre executes and gets clearances) - all true.
Funding wording is tested precisely: 100% of irrigation component cost from 1-4-2014 to the extent of cost as on that date.
App adds many dated 2025-26 progress/finance figures and R&R statistics that APPSC has not asked; core features (river, district, 960 MW, 7.2 lakh acres, GWDT 80 TMC) match exam depth.
